tiktok_title: Sering nyusu bukan tanda ASI kurang. Contekan growth spurt dan perkiraan waktunya
caption:
Tiba-tiba minta nyusu terus dan lebih rewel? Bisa jadi dia lagi growth spurt, masa tumbuh cepat. Biasanya cuma 2-3 hari, terus pola nyusunya balik kayak semula.

Nyusu lebih sering ini bukan karena ASI-mu kurang. Justru dengan nyusu sesering dia mau, produksi ASI ikut nyesuain. Payudara terasa kosong di masa ini juga wajar.

Perkiraan waktunya sekitar umur 2-3 minggu, 6 minggu, 3 bulan dan 5-6 bulan. Tiap bayi beda, bisa maju atau mundur.

Popok basahnya berkurang, bayi lemas, atau berat badannya nggak naik? Langsung cek ke dokter anak atau konselor laktasi.

Bayimu pernah tiba-tiba nyusu terus di umur berapa?

Sumber: HSE Ireland, La Leche League Canada, Maryland Department of Health (WIC)

sources: HSE (Ireland's national health service), Weight gain in breastfed babies: growth spurts at 2 to 3 weeks, 6 weeks, 3 months and 5 to 6 months. Baby may seem hungry all the time and breasts can feel empty (cluster feeding). It may last 2 to 3 days, then baby settles back into a similar pattern. Feeding on demand helps increase milk supply. Best not to limit feeds. A good time to rest. It does not mean they are feeding more because you do not have enough milk. https://www2.hse.ie/wellbeing/child-health/weight-gain-in-breastfed-babies.html

La Leche League Canada, Growth Spurts and Frequent-Feeding Days: expected around 10 days, 3 weeks, 6 weeks, 3 months and 6 months, may happen at any time. After about 48-72 hours baby usually returns to the previous routine. Signs all is well include the same number of wet and dirty diapers and weight gain. Growth spurts are normal and not a sign of low milk supply. https://www.lllc.ca/sites/default/files/Growth%20Spurts%20and%20Frequent-Feeding%20Days-1.pdf

Maryland Department of Health WIC, What is a growth spurt: first about 2 to 3 weeks after birth, others about 6 weeks, 3 months and 6 months, most last 1 to 2 days. Signs: extra fussy or cries more, nurses more often and longer. Nurse when hunger cues appear. Breasts are never empty. https://health.maryland.gov/phpa/wic/Pages/what_is_a_growth_spurt_en.aspx
notes: SHORT format (4 slides). Timing follows HSE (2-3 weeks, 6 weeks, 3 months, 5-6 months), close to Merwyn's list. Sources differ on length (Maryland 1-2 days, HSE 2-3 days, LLL 48-72 h): slides say 'biasanya cuma 2-3 hari'. 'Sering yang pertama kerasa' on the 2-3 week row follows Maryland's 'first growth spurt'. The hook is scoped by the sub line and the wet-diaper safety note, so it does not claim frequent feeding can never mean a problem. Water and snack row is a practical comfort tip, not a supply claim.
